run_inference_on_image: run object detection inference on a single image using detectron models and output a visualization PDF
run_rpn_box_proposals: run region proposal network to generate box proposals and scores from an input image
run_multiple_models: run multiple detectron models in sequence for box detection, segmentation masks, and keypoint prediction
parse_inference_args: parse command line arguments for image path, RPN model, config files, and model pairs to run
check_inference_args: check and validate inference arguments including RPN model files and model config pairs existence
